description: Asserts the single-flight lease guarantee: a deterministic composite lease_key (hash of run_id + stage_execution_id + parent_agent_execution_id + schema_version + frozen_fallback_policy_hash + lease_kind) prevents duplicate repair/fallback dispatch for the same invocation.
guarantee: single-flight dispatch via PRIMARY KEY on lease_key

key_derivation.uniqueness_column: lease_key TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY

scenarios.name: concurrent_repair_dispatch
scenarios.description: Two concurrent orchestrators attempt to insert the same lease_key; the second INSERT must fail with UNIQUE constraint violation
scenarios.second_insert: fails with UNIQUE constraint on PRIMARY KEY

scenarios.name: idempotent_retry_after_lost_ack
scenarios.description: Orchestrator retries after a transport failure but the same lease_key already exists in 'prompt_sent' state; lookup returns existing lease without double-dispatch
scenarios.retry_behavior: lookup existing lease, do not re-insert
